meta.audience: people whose ideas live in scattered notes
meta.title: Orbit Note
meta.reviewed: Written by hand from the app: source/README.md, its design tokens (src/index.css in the app repository) and its captured screens. An electric-blue infinite canvas, glass cards in silver and holographic pastels, white curved links (dashed for wiki links) and the app's holographic trefoil knot.

source.notes: an infinite-canvas note app: cards, links, [[wiki links]] that link by themselves, backlinks, search that flies the camera, force-directed layout
the real app (its production build, served locally) captured by capture/app.json, with the link paths and card boxes read from its DOM (geo.txt); the sample space is the app's own fictional data
Pretendard Variable (the app's face) and JetBrains Mono (labels); SIL OFL 1.1

rationale.palette: The app's canvas: electric blue #0B2FE6 deepening to #0720B0 and #030B4A, white for text and links, silver #F0F2F7 for panels, and its holographic gradient (#9FE9FF, #B9C4FF, #E2B9FF, #FFC6E6, #FFF1B8, #B2F7DD) as the accent, used for the second line of each headline and for glows.
rationale.type: Pretendard Variable bold to heavy, white on blue with tight tracking; the second line of each headline runs through the holographic gradient glyph by glyph; monospaced capitals for labels like the app's 'N°01' and 'CARD / N°09'.
rationale.motion: Fluid, orbital: cards revolve before they settle, the camera glides and zooms like the app's own search flight, links draw on along their real curves with a light pulse running ahead, the knot turns slowly. Nothing snaps; everything eases.
rationale.sound: Cinematic lite in D minor at 96 BPM (6 bars in 15 s, 12 in 30 s): spacious strings and a steady ostinato for an orbit, with glassy SFX (chimes as links land, swells into the drop).
rationale.visuals: Four scenes in the 15 s cut: cards orbiting the holographic knot as the name lands, then settling into the app's own layout; [[ typed in the real inspector, the app's suggestion chosen and a dashed wiki link drawing itself on the canvas; every link of the sample space drawing on along its real path; the end card. The 30 s cut adds search, where the camera flies to the card.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a short, muted launch reel with slogan-length Korean copy shown as type.
